The '''Varada system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Varada sector/Legends|Varada sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Publication information===
The Varada [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in "[[Adversaries: Characters for the Star Wars: New Republic Campaign]]," a [[roleplaying game]] source article authored by [[Bill Slavicsek]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[Polyhedron 97|ninety-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Polyhedron]]'' magazine in [[July]] [[1994]].<ref name="Polyhedron">{{PolyhedronCite|97|Adversaries: Characters for the Star Wars: New Republic Campaign}}</ref> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later provided the first canonical mention of the system in Legends and placed it in grid square I-19.<ref name="TEA" />

===Adversaries: Characters for the Star Wars: New Republic Campaign===
{{Unlicensedstart}}
[[File:TyannaTymb-Polyhedron97.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tyanna Tymb was stationed in the Varada system during the Galactic Civil War.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the celestial body [[Varada Five]] was home to the headquarters of the Varada [[Sector/Legends|sector]] branch of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]],<ref name="Polyhedron" /> a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]]-run conglomerate based on<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]]<ref name="EAOC Sullust">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].<ref name="GATORW" /> During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Sullustan [[Tyanna Tymb]] was appointed to the position of the top operating executive, or [[Top OpEx]], of SoroSuub Corporation's Varada sector holdings. As such, Tymb was charged with controlling the corporation's headquarters on Varada Five as well as coordinating the expansion of her employer's interests in the Varada system and the rest of the sector.<ref name="Polyhedron" />

SoroSuub Corporation home office assigned Tymb to the Varada system shortly after her graduation from the [[SoroSuub Business Academy]], but [[Alara Fax]], the Sullustan's old rival and the head of the company [[Fax Ventures]], had monitored the progress of Tymb's career. That allowed Fax to determine that the only logical post for someone of Tymb's ambitions and talents was a field assignment, in a region that was nominally under the control of SoroSuub Corporation yet had ample room for expansion.<ref name="Polyhedron" />

Before any SoroSuub executives had committed to [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] any decisions on orders to give or promotions to award with regard to Tymb's assignment, Fax guessed that that location would be the Varada system. Thus, Fax gained six [[Standard month/Legends|months']] lead time in which to plan her own economic expansion into the region in order to exact vengeance upon Tymb, who Fax correctly predicted would not be content with exerting influence over just the Varada system and would seek to expand throughout the entire sector.<ref name="Polyhedron" />
{{Unlicensedend}}
